scope: Read-only official-source and exact server-code audit. No server/phone/code mutation, no runtime tuning applied by this reviewer.

officialSources.finding: Netplay expects delayed inputs and uses replay; if unread input is too far behind, it stalls for catch-up without blocking UI. Optional input latency reduces replay frequency/cost. This supports preserving upstream pacing; it does not prescribe Station transport epoch restarts.
Official released source has RUNNING_FAST catch-up and self-clearing condition at lines7600-7612; creation is based on unread/self frame distance at7670-7679. It has no Station TSR2 bridge.

Current upstream retains the same catch-up condition and clearing semantics at7962-7974 and8032-8041 despite other refactoring. No upstream rationale found for treating every RUNNING_FAST occurrence as a transport disconnect/recovery epoch.
The official relay option routes both endpoints through a proxy when direct connectivity is unavailable. It does not make that relay's measured network latency zero.

TCP_NODELAY defaults to on and is enabled for SSL, unbuffered proxying and WebSockets. The effective live nginx configuration still needs operator confirmation; a default document is not proof of production options.

appSocketReview.StationRecoveryTunnel: Remote constructor line154 calls setSocketFactory(tls) and setTcpNoDelay(true); native TCP also true at68.
appSocketReview.WebSocketClient: Actual socket from supplied SSLSocketFactory at575-576 receives socket.setTcpNoDelay(isTcpNoDelay()) at482 before connect491. Writer841-842 writes and flushes each queued frame.
appSocketReview.conclusion: Adding TCP_NODELAY again is not an evidence-backed fix. Physical RTT includes network, queuing and scheduling; client setter absence is ruled out.

serverSendLoopReview.mechanism: StationStreamSession.Changed completes a TaskCompletionSource with asynchronous continuations. Send calls Next, immediately awaits SendAsync for available frames, or awaits Changed when no frame exists.
serverSendLoopReview.locks: Per-match gate covers buffer/state operations bounded to16KiB DATA chunks. Socket SendAsync is outside that gate. PublishState takes the hub lock and updates memory; it does not perform SQL there.
serverSendLoopReview.timers: No100ms/250ms batching sleep found in DATA/PONG forwarding.10s is authority watchdog polling;15s is retained-room pruning. Neither schedules ordinary DATA emission.
serverSendLoopReview.proxy: Versioned ops/nginx-v1-station-relay.conf has proxy_buffering off and proxy_cache off.
serverSendLoopReview.limit: Source inspection cannot rule out live TCP retransmission, proxy overrides, ThreadPool starvation, GC pauses or kernel send queues. No full-path WSS send-latency histogram was supplied.

serverMetricsAlreadyPublished.warning: These are internal command and one-second host samples, not Android RTT, complete auth HTTP duration, native gameplay FPS, or per-frame WSS receive-to-send latency. Do not compare as if they measure identical paths.

pacingFinding.r73Code: netplay_frontend.c9067 marks sticky station_recovery_stalled for RUNNING_FAST; header35 clears only on wait=true; Java tick96-97 emits TSR2 NeedSync13. Upstream can clear RUNNING_FAST before Java's250ms tick while sticky marker remains.
pacingFinding.status: False-positive bridge reproduced in extracted real C and Java probe; independent diff review confirms only three escalation lines removed. Physical epoch storm attribution still requires server NeedSync13 versus detach/suspend records.
pacingFinding.candidateBoundary: Parent authorized removal of only automatic escalation of ordinary pacing; native catch-up, actual socket-loss recovery, authority checks, byte offsets, READY barrier, R73 handshake flush and genuine protocol error handling are preserved.

operatorEvidenceNeeded: For23:52:52-23:53:15UTC, report sanitized NeedSync13 receive counts by host/client and resulting epochs, distinguishing detach, Suspend11, explicit human exit and authority rejection.
Measure receive-complete to queued-frame selection and SendAsync start/end with monotonic durations, by DATA/PONG, using aggregate p50/p95/max rather than per-frame payload logs.
Report gate-wait time, send queue length, ThreadPool/GC pauses, socket RTT/retransmissions and effective nginx settings during the same match interval.
Correlate private connection identities internally; never publish tickets, request proofs, license codes, raw ROM content or personal logs.
